scope: Read-only scientific-method assessment; no new simulations, thresholds, frozen models or completed labels changed

objective.substrate: TA2/titanium; not present as a material model in current M0

verified_size_selection.method: Augmented Latin hypercube, 32 candidate layouts, maximin normalized distance; matched A0/A3 dimensions
verified_size_selection.conclusion: A computational exploration window, not established feasible fabrication limits or exhaustive global design bounds

family_coverage.conclusion: Six fixed representatives include variants of shared topology; insufficient evidence to exclude offset cavities, grooves, round cavities or convex geometries

performance_assessment.normal_cone_weight: cos(theta)*sin(theta); implemented as integration in sin(theta)^2
performance_assessment.selection_product: epsilon_inside * cone_power_fraction is a heuristic, not a derived objective
gaps: continuous cone response and receiver-axis-specific metrics
absolute/footprint-normalized output with source and aperture area controls
azimuth sensitivity and independent ray/angular/profile discretization uncertainty
3-20 um spectral-angular material response and Planck-weighted power at specified temperatures
manufacturing robustness, sidewall loss/scatter/residue and thermal uniformity
performance_assessment.offaxis_note: Integrate full 2D sphere cap using surface-normal projected weight; do not use azimuth averaging before off-axis integration

ideal_surface_assessment.current_boundary: Perfect black absorbing/emitting floor; lossless specular wall and land
ideal_surface_assessment.valid_use: Conditional geometry-only angular-transport and matched wall-shape comparison
invalid_inferences: physical separation of geometry and coating
a universal upper bound for every performance metric
validated 3-20 um or 523 K physical emissivity
ideal_surface_assessment.scale_note: Uniform scale leaves M0 normalized rays invariant; real materials and diffraction require absolute scale and wavelength
ideal_surface_assessment.longwave_note: 20 um is comparable to 10-35 um floors; no established all-band ray approximation

derived_etendue_check.assumptions: Same medium, ideal geometric optics, Lambertian bottom, lossless optics, wish to pass full bottom hemispherical emission through opening into normal cone without rejecting power
derived_etendue_check.necessary_condition: A_open*sin(alpha)^2 >= A_bottom; for similar hexagons sin(alpha)>=b/d
derived_etendue_check.meaning: Narrower collection is possible only with incomplete throughput; this is a derived assessment, not the documented original sizing rationale

next_recommendation: Re-score saved angular data without new physical solves and expose cone-angle and azimuth dependence
Parameterize family descriptors, dimensionless bounds, source area and access constraints before further dense expansion
Run a balanced small family panel with paired ideal and common nonideal surface conditions
Use limited representative full-wave calculations to calibrate the wavelength/angle regions where ray ranking is uncertain; retain quality labels
Train a scoped surrogate with whole-geometry and matched-pair holdout and evaluate generalization separately by family
